scripts.input:
-- Companion marker table: which SMILE bills the agent has already pushed.
-- Kept OUTSIDE SMILE's own tables so we never overload BillInfor.UpInvE
-- (a single bit that cannot hold invoice number / mã CQT and may already be
-- used by SMILE). One row per pushed invoice; presence = pushed.
--
-- SourceHash makes re-collection change-aware: it fingerprints the SMILE
-- source rows that were pushed. A bill is re-collected when it was never
-- pushed OK, OR when its current source fingerprint differs from the stored
-- one (i.e. the source data changed since we last pushed). Combined with the
-- Hub's lifecycle gate, this yields: new -> push; edited-but-unissued ->
-- update; already-issued -> a new version is created Hub-side, never an
-- overwrite of the issued invoice. See dbo.MMEI_SourceHash below.
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.MMEI_Collected', 'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.MMEI_Collected (
    Source        varchar(4)    NOT NULL,   -- 'FO' | 'POS'
    ID            varchar(64)   NOT NULL,   -- FO: BillID ; POS: '<BillSeri>/<BillNo>'
    PushedAt      datetime      NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    Ok            bit           NOT NULL,
    Message       nvarchar(400) NULL,
    InvoiceNumber varchar(30)   NULL,
    KyHieu        varchar(30)   NULL,
    MaCQT         varchar(60)   NULL,
    IssuedAt      datetime      NULL,
    SourceHash    varbinary(32) NULL,        -- SHA-256 of the pushed source rows
    CONSTRAINT PK_MMEI_Collected PRIMARY KEY (Source, ID)
);

-- Idempotent add for installs created before SourceHash existed.
IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.MMEI_Collected', 'SourceHash') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dbo.MMEI_Collected ADD SourceHash varbinary(32) NULL;
GO

scripts.name: 01_source_hash.sql
scripts.input:
-- dbo.MMEI_SourceHash(@Source, @ID) -> varbinary(32)
--
-- The single source-fingerprint used by BOTH the select SPs (to decide whether
-- a bill changed since last push) and sp_MarkCollected (to record what was
-- pushed). Defining it once guarantees the two sides compute an identical hash
-- from identical inputs — the whole change-detection contract depends on that.
--
-- It must fingerprint every source column that flows into the pushed payload:
-- the header money/buyer fields AND a stable checksum over the child charge /
-- item rows. If the DBA extends a fetch SP with more source columns, mirror the
-- addition here so an edit to those columns triggers a re-collect.
--
-- A scalar UDF may NOT run EXEC / sp_executesql (SQL Server error 557), so the
-- FO branch — whose revenue predicate + 3 probe columns vary by schema — is made
-- STATIC by having the Go installer (InstallCollectSQLString) substitute the
-- schema-dependent fragments at install time. It probes the SAME COL_LENGTH /
-- OBJECT_ID conditions sp_FetchFO uses and replaces the /*{{…}}*/ placeholder
-- tokens below before CREATE OR ALTER, so the installed body statically
-- references only columns that exist on THIS install. Never hand-run this file
-- with the tokens unresolved — install it through the Go path.
--
-- Deploy AFTER 00_marker_table.sql and BEFORE the SPs.
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION dbo.MMEI_SourceHash (@Source varchar(4), @ID varchar(64))
RETURNS varbinary(32)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sig nvarchar(max) = N'';

    IF @Source = 'FO'
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @BillID numeric = TRY_CONVERT(numeric, @ID);

        -- ĐỢT 2 FO revenue predicate — the fenced block below is byte-identical
        -- (after whitespace normalisation) to sp_FetchFO's fenced block, so the
        -- Go drift guard's cross-file parity check passes. sp_FetchFO picks its
        -- predicate at RUN time via sp_executesql (legal in an SP); this scalar
        -- UDF cannot, so the installer resolves the SAME branch at INSTALL time
        -- and substitutes the static WHERE at /*{{FO_STATIC_PRED}}*/ below. The
        -- @pred builder here is kept verbatim (for fence parity) and its value is
        -- intentionally unreferenced — the static predicate carries the filter.
        /*MMEI_FO_PREDICATE*/
        DECLARE @pred nvarchar(max);
        IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.TransactionCode', 'TransactionGroup') IS NOT NULL
           AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'FolioBalanceCode') IS NOT NULL
            SET @pred = N'EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TransactionCode tcp WHERE tcp.TransactionCode = ft.TransactionCode AND tcp.TransactionGroup = 1) AND ft.FolioBalanceCode NOT IN (''P'', ''V'', ''C'')';
        ELSE
            SET @pred = N'ft.TransactionCode IN (''110'', ''150'', ''160'', ''170'', ''200'', ''201'', ''210'', ''211'', ''220'', ''221'', ''230'', ''240'')';
        /*END_MMEI_FO_PREDICATE*/

        -- Header fields that flow into the payload (money + buyer + content).
        -- CONCAT (not CONCAT_WS, which is SQL Server 2017+ — unavailable on the
        -- customer's 2016 RTM box) with '|' spliced between every argument.
        -- CONCAT null-coalesces each arg to '', matching CONCAT_WS's NULL
        -- handling closely enough here since every arg is already ISNULL/CAST-wrapped.
        SELECT @sig = CONCAT(
            ISNULL(b.CompanyName, ''), '|', ISNULL(b.VATCode, ''), '|', ISNULL(b.Address1, ''), '|',
            -- Buyer email flows from the folio's first guest profile, not b.EMail
            -- (see sp_FetchFO CustomerEmail). Hash the SAME resolved value so an
            -- edit to the guest's Profile.Email re-collects the bill; fall back to
            -- b.EMail exactly as the fetch does, so the fingerprint tracks the
            -- payload byte-for-byte.
            ISNULL(NULLIF((
                SELECT TOP (1) p.Email
                FROM dbo.GuestEveryDay g
                JOIN dbo.Profile p ON p.ProfileNumber = g.ProfileID
                WHERE g.FolioNum = b.FolioNum
                  AND g.IsAdditionalName = 1
                  AND g.ProfileID > 0
                  AND p.Email IS NOT NULL AND p.Email <> ''
                ORDER BY g.FolioSubNum, g.GuestID
            ), ''), ISNULL(b.EMail, '')), '|', ISNULL(b.BillSeri1, ''), '|',
            ISNULL(CAST(b.BillNumber1From AS varchar(30)), ''), '|',
            CONVERT(varchar(19), b.InvDate, 120), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.SubAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.ServiceCharge, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.TaxAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.TotalAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            ISNULL(b.GuestName, ''), '|', ISNULL(b.Address2, ''), '|', ISNULL(b.BillNote, ''), '|',
            -- Cancel/print state: a cancel or re-print must re-collect.
            CAST(ISNULL(b.Cancel, 0) AS varchar(4)), '|', CAST(ISNULL(b.Printed, 0) AS varchar(4)))
        FROM dbo.BillInfor b WHERE b.BillID = @BillID;

        -- Child charge lines (order-independent aggregate). Any change to a
        -- folio charge's identity or NET amount alters the checksum. Each
        -- per-row hash is reduced modulo a large prime BEFORE summing — a bill
        -- can carry enough charge rows that summing raw MD5-derived bigints
        -- (each up to ~2^63 in magnitude) overflows bigint (verified live on
        -- SMILE_FO). The modulo keeps every addend small while remaining a
        -- deterministic, order-independent function of each row's content —
        -- matching the POS branch's #TRN aggregate below. STATIC: the revenue
        -- predicate and the 3 probe columns (TrnGroup/IsHKPost/TaxRate) are
        -- resolved at INSTALL time via the /*{{…}}*/ tokens, so no dynamic SQL.
        SELECT @sig = CONCAT(@sig, N'#FT:',
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
                CAST(ft.TransactionID AS varchar(30)), '|', ISNULL(ft.TransactionCode, ''), '|',
                ISNULL(CAST(ft.TransactionSubCode AS varchar(10)), ''), '|',
                ISNULL(tc.Description, ''), '|',
                ISNULL(ft.Description, ''), '|',
                CAST(ISNULL(ft.Quantity, 1) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.SubAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.TaxAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                ISNULL(ft.STaxCode, ''), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.STaxAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.ServiceCharge, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                -- ĐỢT 2 raw classification columns, fingerprinted so an edit
                -- to the catalog group, the HK flag, or the TaxDef rate recollects.
                -- Each expression below is substituted by the installer: the real
                -- column ref when present, or the literal fallback ('' / '0') when
                -- absent — matching sp_FetchFO's own probe fallbacks so the hash
                -- never drifts from what the fetch SP emits.
                '', '|',
                '0', '|',
                '')) AS bigint) % 999999999989) AS varchar(40)), '0'),
            N':', CAST(COUNT(*) AS varchar(20)))
        FROM dbo.FolioTransaction ft
        LEFT JOIN dbo.TransactionCode tc
            ON tc.TransactionCode = ft.TransactionCode
           AND tc.TransactionSubCode = CAST(ft.TransactionSubCode AS varchar)
        
        WHERE ft.BillID = @BillID
          AND (ft.TransactionCode IN ('110', '150', '160', '170', '200', '201', '210', '211', '220', '221', '230', '240'));

        -- Detail items (order-independent aggregate). Same modulo-before-sum
        -- guard as the folio aggregate above (bill 10384's detail alone spans
        -- multiple charges' rows; raw bigint sums overflow live). Its parent
        -- subquery reuses the SAME static predicate so it fingerprints exactly
        -- the detail rows sp_FetchFO's result set 3 emits.
        SELECT @sig = CONCAT(@sig, N'#IP:',
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
                CAST(ip.TrnID AS varchar(30)), '|', ISNULL(ip.ICode, ''), '|',
                ISNULL(ip.IName, ''), '|',
                ISNULL(ig.GroupName, ''), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.Price, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ISNULL(ip.Qty, 1) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.Amount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)))) AS bigint) % 999999999989) AS varchar(40)), '0'),
            N':', CAST(COUNT(*) AS varchar(20)))
        FROM dbo.ItemPosted ip
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ItemList il ON RTRIM(il.ICode) = RTRIM(ip.ICode)
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ItemGroup ig ON RTRIM(ig.GroupCode) = RTRIM(il.IGroup)
        WHERE ip.TrnID IN (
            SELECT ft.TransactionID FROM dbo.FolioTransaction ft
            WHERE ft.BillID = @BillID
              AND (ft.TransactionCode IN ('110', '150', '160', '170', '200', '201', '210', '211', '220', '221', '230', '240')));
    END
    ELSE IF @Source = 'POS'
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @CheckNo numeric = TRY_CONVERT(numeric, @ID);

        -- Header fields that flow into the payload: check-level money + status
        -- + TaxOmit (VAT-omission flag → KCT) + the FolioNum dedup gate, plus
        -- the TaxTable buyer identity sp_FetchPOS v2 now reads (a buyer-info
        -- edit must trigger a recollect). LEFT JOIN so a check with no TaxTable
        -- row still fingerprints (matching the fetch SP's join).
        -- CONCAT (not CONCAT_WS, 2017+ only) with '|' spliced between args;
        -- CONCAT null-coalesces each arg to '', so a NULL CloseTime/OpenTime
        -- pair no longer nulls out the whole signature the way `+` would.
        SELECT @sig = CONCAT(
            CAST(i.CheckNo AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CONVERT(varchar(19), ISNULL(i.CloseTime, i.OpenTime), 120), '|',
            -- The payload InvDate takes its CALENDAR date from IYear/IMonth/IDay
            -- (CloseTime supplies only the time-of-day; sp_FetchPOS builds it that
            -- way because CloseTime lacks a stable calendar date on this schema).
            -- The CloseTime component above therefore does NOT protect the invoice
            -- date — fingerprint the integer date parts here or a ngày-lập edit is
            -- silently missed.
            CAST(ISNULL(i.IYear, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            CAST(ISNULL(i.IMonth, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            CAST(ISNULL(i.IDay, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.SubTotal, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.TaxTotal, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            -- STaxTotal (thuế TTĐB) rides its own header field into the payload and
            -- projects a "Thuế đặc biệt" wire line; a special-tax edit must recollect.
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.STaxTotal, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.TotalBase, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.Discount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.SurCharge, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ISNULL(i.InvStatus, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            CAST(ISNULL(i.Status, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            CAST(ISNULL(i.TaxOmit, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            ISNULL(CAST(i.RVC AS varchar(10)), ''), '|',
            ISNULL(CAST(i.FolioNum AS varchar(30)), ''), '|',
            ISNULL(tt.ClientVAT, ''), '|', ISNULL(tt.Company, ''), '|',
            ISNULL(tt.ClientName, ''), '|', ISNULL(tt.Address, ''), '|',
            -- InvContent flows into the collected header (nội dung hóa đơn), so an
            -- edit to it on an un-issued check must re-collect; fingerprint it here
            -- or the change is silently missed.
            ISNULL(tt.InvContent, ''))
        FROM dbo.Invoice i
        LEFT JOIN dbo.TaxTable tt ON tt.TCheckNo = i.CheckNo
        WHERE i.CheckNo = @CheckNo;

        -- Line rows (order-independent aggregate). Both revenue (TrnCode=100)
        -- and discount (110) rows are fingerprinted over their identity + the
        -- EXACT per-line money (BaseSub/BaseTax/TaxNo + BaseSTax/STaxNo) that
        -- sp_FetchPOS v2 reads — an edit to a line's net/VAT/rate bucket, its
        -- special-tax (TTĐB) amount/rate, or a discount row change alters the
        -- checksum. Adding/removing a row changes the COUNT too.
        --
        -- NOTE: unlike the FO branch's SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES(...) AS bigint)),
        -- here each per-row hash is reduced modulo a large prime BEFORE
        -- summing. A POS check can carry 30+ lines (verified: check 200021306
        -- has 35), and summing raw MD5-derived bigints (each up to ~2^63 in
        -- magnitude) overflows bigint well before the FO side's typical row
        -- counts would — verified live via arithmetic overflow on SMILE_POS.
        -- The modulo keeps every addend small while remaining a deterministic,
        -- order-independent function of each row's content.
        SELECT @sig = CONCAT(@sig, N'#TRN:',
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
                CAST(t.TrnSeq AS varchar(30)), '|', CAST(ISNULL(t.TrnCode, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
                ISNULL(t.ItemCode, ''), '|',
                -- Per-line t.RVC (distinct from the header i.RVC hashed above): it
                -- flows to Origin.RVC and is exposed as the {RVC} line-name template
                -- var, so a template using {RVC} renders it into the pushed wire line.
                -- Editing one line's Trn.RVC changes the payload; hash it so a lone
                -- RVC edit (no other co-hashed column touched) still re-collects.
                CAST(ISNULL(t.RVC, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
                -- TrnDesc (wire line name via sp_FetchPOS Description → payload Name)
                -- and ItemPrice (wire UnitPrice, an independent column NOT re-derived
                -- from BaseSub/Qty) both flow into the pushed line — mirror the FO #IP
                -- branch (IName/Price) so a name fix, or a unit-price edit at constant
                -- BaseSub/Qty, still triggers a re-collect.
                ISNULL(t.TrnDesc, ''), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.ItemPrice, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ISNULL(t.TrnQty, 1) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseSub, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseTax, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ISNULL(t.TaxNo, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseSTax, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ISNULL(t.STaxNo, 0) AS varchar(10)))) AS bigint) % 999999999989) AS varchar(40)), '0'),
            N':', CAST(COUNT(*) AS varchar(20)))
        FROM dbo.Trn t
        WHERE t.CheckNo = @CheckNo
          AND t.TrnCode IN (100, 110);
    END

    RETURN CASE WHEN @sig IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', @sig) END;
END;
GO

-- dbo.MMEI_SourceHash(@Source, @ID) -> varbinary(32)
--
-- The single source-fingerprint used by BOTH the select SPs (to decide whether
-- a bill changed since last push) and sp_MarkCollected (to record what was
-- pushed). Defining it once guarantees the two sides compute an identical hash
-- from identical inputs — the whole change-detection contract depends on that.
--
-- It must fingerprint every source column that flows into the pushed payload:
-- the header money/buyer fields AND a stable checksum over the child charge /
-- item rows. If the DBA extends a fetch SP with more source columns, mirror the
-- addition here so an edit to those columns triggers a re-collect.
--
-- A scalar UDF may NOT run EXEC / sp_executesql (SQL Server error 557), so the
-- FO branch — whose revenue predicate + 3 probe columns vary by schema — is made
-- STATIC by having the Go installer (InstallCollectSQLString) substitute the
-- schema-dependent fragments at install time. It probes the SAME COL_LENGTH /
-- OBJECT_ID conditions sp_FetchFO uses and replaces the /*{{…}}*/ placeholder
-- tokens below before CREATE OR ALTER, so the installed body statically
-- references only columns that exist on THIS install. Never hand-run this file
-- with the tokens unresolved — install it through the Go path.
--
-- Deploy AFTER 00_marker_table.sql and BEFORE the SPs.
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION dbo.MMEI_SourceHash (@Source varchar(4), @ID varchar(64))
RETURNS varbinary(32)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sig nvarchar(max) = N'';

    IF @Source = 'FO'
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @BillID numeric = TRY_CONVERT(numeric, @ID);

        -- ĐỢT 2 FO revenue predicate — the fenced block below is byte-identical
        -- (after whitespace normalisation) to sp_FetchFO's fenced block, so the
        -- Go drift guard's cross-file parity check passes. sp_FetchFO picks its
        -- predicate at RUN time via sp_executesql (legal in an SP); this scalar
        -- UDF cannot, so the installer resolves the SAME branch at INSTALL time
        -- and substitutes the static WHERE at /*{{FO_STATIC_PRED}}*/ below. The
        -- @pred builder here is kept verbatim (for fence parity) and its value is
        -- intentionally unreferenced — the static predicate carries the filter.
        /*MMEI_FO_PREDICATE*/
        DECLARE @pred nvarchar(max);
        IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.TransactionCode', 'TransactionGroup') IS NOT NULL
           AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'FolioBalanceCode') IS NOT NULL
            SET @pred = N'EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TransactionCode tcp WHERE tcp.TransactionCode = ft.TransactionCode AND tcp.TransactionGroup = 1) AND ft.FolioBalanceCode NOT IN (''P'', ''V'', ''C'')';
        ELSE
            SET @pred = N'ft.TransactionCode IN (''110'', ''150'', ''160'', ''170'', ''200'', ''201'', ''210'', ''211'', ''220'', ''221'', ''230'', ''240'')';
        /*END_MMEI_FO_PREDICATE*/

        -- Header fields that flow into the payload (money + buyer + content).
        -- CONCAT (not CONCAT_WS, which is SQL Server 2017+ — unavailable on the
        -- customer's 2016 RTM box) with '|' spliced between every argument.
        -- CONCAT null-coalesces each arg to '', matching CONCAT_WS's NULL
        -- handling closely enough here since every arg is already ISNULL/CAST-wrapped.
        SELECT @sig = CONCAT(
            ISNULL(b.CompanyName, ''), '|', ISNULL(b.VATCode, ''), '|', ISNULL(b.Address1, ''), '|',
            -- Buyer email flows from the folio's first guest profile, not b.EMail
            -- (see sp_FetchFO CustomerEmail). Hash the SAME resolved value so an
            -- edit to the guest's Profile.Email re-collects the bill; fall back to
            -- b.EMail exactly as the fetch does, so the fingerprint tracks the
            -- payload byte-for-byte.
            ISNULL(NULLIF((
                SELECT TOP (1) p.Email
                FROM dbo.GuestEveryDay g
                JOIN dbo.Profile p ON p.ProfileNumber = g.ProfileID
                WHERE g.FolioNum = b.FolioNum
                  AND g.IsAdditionalName = 1
                  AND g.ProfileID > 0
                  AND p.Email IS NOT NULL AND p.Email <> ''
                ORDER BY g.FolioSubNum, g.GuestID
            ), ''), ISNULL(b.EMail, '')), '|', ISNULL(b.BillSeri1, ''), '|',
            ISNULL(CAST(b.BillNumber1From AS varchar(30)), ''), '|',
            CONVERT(varchar(19), b.InvDate, 120), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.SubAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.ServiceCharge, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.TaxAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.TotalAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            ISNULL(b.GuestName, ''), '|', ISNULL(b.Address2, ''), '|', ISNULL(b.BillNote, ''), '|',
            -- Cancel/print state: a cancel or re-print must re-collect.
            CAST(ISNULL(b.Cancel, 0) AS varchar(4)), '|', CAST(ISNULL(b.Printed, 0) AS varchar(4)))
        FROM dbo.BillInfor b WHERE b.BillID = @BillID;

        -- Child charge lines (order-independent aggregate). Any change to a
        -- folio charge's identity or NET amount alters the checksum. Each
        -- per-row hash is reduced modulo a large prime BEFORE summing — a bill
        -- can carry enough charge rows that summing raw MD5-derived bigints
        -- (each up to ~2^63 in magnitude) overflows bigint (verified live on
        -- SMILE_FO). The modulo keeps every addend small while remaining a
        -- deterministic, order-independent function of each row's content —
        -- matching the POS branch's #TRN aggregate below. STATIC: the revenue
        -- predicate and the 3 probe columns (TrnGroup/IsHKPost/TaxRate) are
        -- resolved at INSTALL time via the /*{{…}}*/ tokens, so no dynamic SQL.
        SELECT @sig = CONCAT(@sig, N'#FT:',
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
                CAST(ft.TransactionID AS varchar(30)), '|', ISNULL(ft.TransactionCode, ''), '|',
                ISNULL(CAST(ft.TransactionSubCode AS varchar(10)), ''), '|',
                ISNULL(tc.Description, ''), '|',
                ISNULL(ft.Description, ''), '|',
                CAST(ISNULL(ft.Quantity, 1) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.SubAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.TaxAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                ISNULL(ft.STaxCode, ''), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.STaxAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.ServiceCharge, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                -- ĐỢT 2 raw classification columns, fingerprinted so an edit
                -- to the catalog group, the HK flag, or the TaxDef rate recollects.
                -- Each expression below is substituted by the installer: the real
                -- column ref when present, or the literal fallback ('' / '0') when
                -- absent — matching sp_FetchFO's own probe fallbacks so the hash
                -- never drifts from what the fetch SP emits.
                ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(tc.TransactionGroup AS varchar(20))), ''), '|',
                CAST(CAST(ISNULL(ft.isHKPost, 0) AS bit) AS varchar(1)), '|',
                ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(td.TaxRate AS varchar(20))), ''))) AS bigint) % 999999999989) AS varchar(40)), '0'),
            N':', CAST(COUNT(*) AS varchar(20)))
        FROM dbo.FolioTransaction ft
        LEFT JOIN dbo.TransactionCode tc
            ON tc.TransactionCode = ft.TransactionCode
           AND tc.TransactionSubCode = CAST(ft.TransactionSubCode AS varchar)
        LEFT JOIN dbo.TaxDef td ON td.TaxCode = ft.TaxCode
        WHERE ft.BillID = @BillID
          AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TransactionCode tcp WHERE tcp.TransactionCode = ft.TransactionCode AND tcp.TransactionGroup = 1) AND ft.FolioBalanceCode NOT IN ('P', 'V', 'C'));

        -- Detail items (order-independent aggregate). Same modulo-before-sum
        -- guard as the folio aggregate above (bill 10384's detail alone spans
        -- multiple charges' rows; raw bigint sums overflow live). Its parent
        -- subquery reuses the SAME static predicate so it fingerprints exactly
        -- the detail rows sp_FetchFO's result set 3 emits.
        SELECT @sig = CONCAT(@sig, N'#IP:',
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
                CAST(ip.TrnID AS varchar(30)), '|', ISNULL(ip.ICode, ''), '|',
                ISNULL(ip.IName, ''), '|',
                ISNULL(ig.GroupName, ''), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.Price, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ISNULL(ip.Qty, 1) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.Amount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)))) AS bigint) % 999999999989) AS varchar(40)), '0'),
            N':', CAST(COUNT(*) AS varchar(20)))
        FROM dbo.ItemPosted ip
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ItemList il ON RTRIM(il.ICode) = RTRIM(ip.ICode)
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ItemGroup ig ON RTRIM(ig.GroupCode) = RTRIM(il.IGroup)
        WHERE ip.TrnID IN (
            SELECT ft.TransactionID FROM dbo.FolioTransaction ft
            WHERE ft.BillID = @BillID
              AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TransactionCode tcp WHERE tcp.TransactionCode = ft.TransactionCode AND tcp.TransactionGroup = 1) AND ft.FolioBalanceCode NOT IN ('P', 'V', 'C')));
    END
    ELSE IF @Source = 'POS'
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @CheckNo numeric = TRY_CONVERT(numeric, @ID);

        -- Header fields that flow into the payload: check-level money + status
        -- + TaxOmit (VAT-omission flag → KCT) + the FolioNum dedup gate, plus
        -- the TaxTable buyer identity sp_FetchPOS v2 now reads (a buyer-info
        -- edit must trigger a recollect). LEFT JOIN so a check with no TaxTable
        -- row still fingerprints (matching the fetch SP's join).
        -- CONCAT (not CONCAT_WS, 2017+ only) with '|' spliced between args;
        -- CONCAT null-coalesces each arg to '', so a NULL CloseTime/OpenTime
        -- pair no longer nulls out the whole signature the way `+` would.
        SELECT @sig = CONCAT(
            CAST(i.CheckNo AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CONVERT(varchar(19), ISNULL(i.CloseTime, i.OpenTime), 120), '|',
            -- The payload InvDate takes its CALENDAR date from IYear/IMonth/IDay
            -- (CloseTime supplies only the time-of-day; sp_FetchPOS builds it that
            -- way because CloseTime lacks a stable calendar date on this schema).
            -- The CloseTime component above therefore does NOT protect the invoice
            -- date — fingerprint the integer date parts here or a ngày-lập edit is
            -- silently missed.
            CAST(ISNULL(i.IYear, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            CAST(ISNULL(i.IMonth, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            CAST(ISNULL(i.IDay, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.SubTotal, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.TaxTotal, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            -- STaxTotal (thuế TTĐB) rides its own header field into the payload and
            -- projects a "Thuế đặc biệt" wire line; a special-tax edit must recollect.
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.STaxTotal, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.TotalBase, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.Discount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.SurCharge, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
            CAST(ISNULL(i.InvStatus, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            CAST(ISNULL(i.Status, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            CAST(ISNULL(i.TaxOmit, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
            ISNULL(CAST(i.RVC AS varchar(10)), ''), '|',
            ISNULL(CAST(i.FolioNum AS varchar(30)), ''), '|',
            ISNULL(tt.ClientVAT, ''), '|', ISNULL(tt.Company, ''), '|',
            ISNULL(tt.ClientName, ''), '|', ISNULL(tt.Address, ''), '|',
            -- InvContent flows into the collected header (nội dung hóa đơn), so an
            -- edit to it on an un-issued check must re-collect; fingerprint it here
            -- or the change is silently missed.
            ISNULL(tt.InvContent, ''))
        FROM dbo.Invoice i
        LEFT JOIN dbo.TaxTable tt ON tt.TCheckNo = i.CheckNo
        WHERE i.CheckNo = @CheckNo;

        -- Line rows (order-independent aggregate). Both revenue (TrnCode=100)
        -- and discount (110) rows are fingerprinted over their identity + the
        -- EXACT per-line money (BaseSub/BaseTax/TaxNo + BaseSTax/STaxNo) that
        -- sp_FetchPOS v2 reads — an edit to a line's net/VAT/rate bucket, its
        -- special-tax (TTĐB) amount/rate, or a discount row change alters the
        -- checksum. Adding/removing a row changes the COUNT too.
        --
        -- NOTE: unlike the FO branch's SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES(...) AS bigint)),
        -- here each per-row hash is reduced modulo a large prime BEFORE
        -- summing. A POS check can carry 30+ lines (verified: check 200021306
        -- has 35), and summing raw MD5-derived bigints (each up to ~2^63 in
        -- magnitude) overflows bigint well before the FO side's typical row
        -- counts would — verified live via arithmetic overflow on SMILE_POS.
        -- The modulo keeps every addend small while remaining a deterministic,
        -- order-independent function of each row's content.
        SELECT @sig = CONCAT(@sig, N'#TRN:',
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
                CAST(t.TrnSeq AS varchar(30)), '|', CAST(ISNULL(t.TrnCode, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
                ISNULL(t.ItemCode, ''), '|',
                -- Per-line t.RVC (distinct from the header i.RVC hashed above): it
                -- flows to Origin.RVC and is exposed as the {RVC} line-name template
                -- var, so a template using {RVC} renders it into the pushed wire line.
                -- Editing one line's Trn.RVC changes the payload; hash it so a lone
                -- RVC edit (no other co-hashed column touched) still re-collects.
                CAST(ISNULL(t.RVC, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
                -- TrnDesc (wire line name via sp_FetchPOS Description → payload Name)
                -- and ItemPrice (wire UnitPrice, an independent column NOT re-derived
                -- from BaseSub/Qty) both flow into the pushed line — mirror the FO #IP
                -- branch (IName/Price) so a name fix, or a unit-price edit at constant
                -- BaseSub/Qty, still triggers a re-collect.
                ISNULL(t.TrnDesc, ''), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.ItemPrice, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ISNULL(t.TrnQty, 1) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseSub, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseTax, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ISNULL(t.TaxNo, 0) AS varchar(10)), '|',
                CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseSTax, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)), '|',
                CAST(ISNULL(t.STaxNo, 0) AS varchar(10)))) AS bigint) % 999999999989) AS varchar(40)), '0'),
            N':', CAST(COUNT(*) AS varchar(20)))
        FROM dbo.Trn t
        WHERE t.CheckNo = @CheckNo
          AND t.TrnCode IN (100, 110);
    END

    RETURN CASE WHEN @sig IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', @sig) END;
END;
GO

            ISNULL(CAST(CONVERT(varchar(19), b.InvDate, 120) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.SubAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.ServiceCharge, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.TaxAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.TotalAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(b.GuestName, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(b.Address2, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(b.BillNote, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(b.Cancel, 0) AS varchar(4)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(b.Printed, 0) AS varchar(4)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N''))
        FROM dbo.BillInfor b WHERE b.BillID = @BillID;

        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        SELECT @sig = (ISNULL(CAST(@sig AS nvarchar(max)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(N'#FT:' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(CAST(SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES('MD5', (
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ft.TransactionID AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(ft.TransactionCode, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(CAST(ft.TransactionSubCode AS varchar(10)), '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(tc.Description, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(ft.Description, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(ft.Quantity, 1) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.SubAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.TaxAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(ft.STaxCode, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.STaxAmount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.ServiceCharge, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                
                
                
                
                
                
                ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(tc.TransactionGroup AS varchar(20))), '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(ft.isHKPost, 0) AS bit) AS varchar(1)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(td.TaxRate AS varchar(20))), '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N''))) AS bigint) % 999999999989) AS varchar(40)), '0') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(N':' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(CAST(COUNT(*) AS varchar(20)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N''))
        FROM dbo.FolioTransaction ft
        LEFT JOIN dbo.TransactionCode tc
            ON tc.TransactionCode = ft.TransactionCode
           AND tc.TransactionSubCode = CAST(ft.TransactionSubCode AS varchar)
        LEFT JOIN dbo.TaxDef td ON td.TaxCode = ft.TaxCode
        WHERE ft.BillID = @BillID
          AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TransactionCode tcp WHERE tcp.TransactionCode = ft.TransactionCode AND tcp.TransactionGroup = 1) AND ft.FolioBalanceCode NOT IN ('P', 'V', 'C'));

        
        
        
        
        
        SELECT @sig = (ISNULL(CAST(@sig AS nvarchar(max)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(N'#IP:' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(CAST(SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES('MD5', (
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ip.TrnID AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(ip.ICode, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(ip.IName, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(ig.GroupName, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.Price, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(ip.Qty, 1) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.Amount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N''))) AS bigint) % 999999999989) AS varchar(40)), '0') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(N':' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(CAST(COUNT(*) AS varchar(20)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N''))
        FROM dbo.ItemPosted ip
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ItemList il ON RTRIM(il.ICode) = RTRIM(ip.ICode)
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ItemGroup ig ON RTRIM(ig.GroupCode) = RTRIM(il.IGroup)
        WHERE ip.TrnID IN (
            SELECT ft.TransactionID FROM dbo.FolioTransaction ft
            WHERE ft.BillID = @BillID
              AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TransactionCode tcp WHERE tcp.TransactionCode = ft.TransactionCode AND tcp.TransactionGroup = 1) AND ft.FolioBalanceCode NOT IN ('P', 'V', 'C')));
    END
    ELSE IF @Source = 'POS'
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @CheckNo numeric = CASE WHEN LEN(@ID) BETWEEN 1 AND 18 AND @ID NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%' THEN CONVERT(numeric, @ID) END;

        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        SELECT @sig = (
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(i.CheckNo AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CONVERT(varchar(19), ISNULL(i.CloseTime, i.OpenTime), 120) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            
            
            
            
            
            
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(i.IYear, 0) AS varchar(10)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(i.IMonth, 0) AS varchar(10)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(i.IDay, 0) AS varchar(10)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.SubTotal, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.TaxTotal, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            
            
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.STaxTotal, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.TotalBase, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.Discount, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.SurCharge, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(i.InvStatus, 0) AS varchar(10)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(i.Status, 0) AS varchar(10)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(i.TaxOmit, 0) AS varchar(10)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(CAST(i.RVC AS varchar(10)), '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(CAST(i.FolioNum AS varchar(30)), '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ClientVAT, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(tt.Company, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ClientName, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(tt.Address, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            
            
            
            ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(tt.InvContent, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N''))
        FROM dbo.Invoice i
        LEFT JOIN dbo.TaxTable tt ON tt.TCheckNo = i.CheckNo
        WHERE i.CheckNo = @CheckNo;

        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        SELECT @sig = (ISNULL(CAST(@sig AS nvarchar(max)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(N'#TRN:' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(CAST(SUM(CAST(HASHBYTES('MD5', (
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(t.TrnSeq AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(t.TrnCode, 0) AS varchar(10)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(t.ItemCode, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                
                
                
                
                
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(t.RVC, 0) AS varchar(10)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                
                
                
                
                
                ISNULL(CAST(ISNULL(t.TrnDesc, '') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.ItemPrice, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(t.TrnQty, 1) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseSub, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseTax, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(t.TaxNo, 0) AS varchar(10)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseSTax, 0), 0) AS varchar(30)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST('|' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
                ISNULL(CAST(CAST(ISNULL(t.STaxNo, 0) AS varchar(10)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N''))) AS bigint) % 999999999989) AS varchar(40)), '0') AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') +
            ISNULL(CAST(N':' AS nvarchar(4000)), N'') + ISNULL(CAST(CAST(COUNT(*) AS varchar(20)) AS nvarchar(4000)), N''))
        FROM dbo.Trn t
        WHERE t.CheckNo = @CheckNo
          AND t.TrnCode IN (100, 110);
    END

    RETURN CASE WHEN @sig IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (HASHBYTES('SHA1', CAST(SUBSTRING(@sig, 1, 4000) AS nvarchar(4000))) + SUBSTRING(HASHBYTES('SHA1', CAST(SUBSTRING(@sig, 4001, 4000) AS nvarchar(4000))), 1, 12)) END;
END;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_FetchFO @ID varchar(64) AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @BillID numeric = TRY_CONVERT(numeric, @ID);

    -- Two-tier FO revenue filter (ĐỢT 2). The revenue-line predicate is built
    -- ONCE here and reused for result set 2 and result set 3's subquery so both
    -- select the SAME row set. It PROBES the install's schema:
    --   * both dbo.TransactionCode.TransactionGroup AND
    --     dbo.FolioTransaction.FolioBalanceCode present → the optimal predicate
    --     (TransactionGroup=1 revenue class, minus void/cancel/payment balances),
    --   * otherwise → the legacy 12-code IN-list, so a schema variant that lacks
    --     the new columns NEVER loses revenue (falls back to today's behaviour).
    -- The predicate travels as text through sp_executesql because the WHERE
    -- itself changes with the probe; the fenced block below is byte-identical
    -- (after whitespace normalisation) to the copies in sp_FetchFO result set 3
    -- and in 01_source_hash.sql (#FT/#IP), which the Go drift guard compares.
    /*MMEI_FO_PREDICATE*/
    DECLARE @pred nvarchar(max);
    IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.TransactionCode', 'TransactionGroup') IS NOT NULL
       AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'FolioBalanceCode') IS NOT NULL
        SET @pred = N'EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TransactionCode tcp WHERE tcp.TransactionCode = ft.TransactionCode AND tcp.TransactionGroup = 1) AND ft.FolioBalanceCode NOT IN (''P'', ''V'', ''C'')';
    ELSE
        SET @pred = N'ft.TransactionCode IN (''110'', ''150'', ''160'', ''170'', ''200'', ''201'', ''210'', ''211'', ''220'', ''221'', ''230'', ''240'')';
    /*END_MMEI_FO_PREDICATE*/

    -- ItemPosted's tax grain varies PER ITEM GROUP, not per install: earlier
    -- revisions probed COL_LENGTH(TaxAmount/ServiceChargeAmount) as a proxy for
    -- gross-vs-net, but VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-30 (local SMILE_FO, 3330-row full
    -- scan) those columns exist on ItemPosted regardless of convention — the
    -- real switch is dbo.ItemGroup.IsPriceNet, reached via
    -- ItemPosted.ICode -> ItemList.ICode -> ItemList.IGroup = ItemGroup.GroupCode
    -- (Price*Qty == Amount held for all 3330 rows where IsPriceNet=1; 0
    -- mismatches). @ipHasTax now gates only whether the tax/STax/SC columns are
    -- PRESENT on this install (schema-variant fallback, unrelated to net/gross);
    -- @ipIsNet (declared with the join in result set 3, since it needs ig) picks
    -- the net/gross formula per that item's own group setting.
    DECLARE @ipHasTax bit =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.ItemPosted', 'TaxAmount') IS NOT NULL
              AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.ItemPosted', 'ServiceChargeAmount') IS NOT NULL
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

    -- Column-probe expressions for the 3 raw classification columns result set 2
    -- appends (TrnGroup/IsHKPost/TaxRate). Each is '' / 0 when its column or
    -- table is absent, so an install missing them never zeroes a folio line.
    DECLARE @grpExpr  nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.TransactionCode', 'TransactionGroup') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(tc.TransactionGroup AS varchar(20))), '''')'
             ELSE N'''''' END;
    DECLARE @hkExpr   nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'isHKPost') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'CAST(ISNULL(ft.isHKPost, 0) AS bit)'
             ELSE N'CAST(0 AS bit)' END;
    DECLARE @rateExpr nvarchar(400) =
        CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID('dbo.TaxDef') IS NOT NULL
              AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.TaxDef', 'TaxRate') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(td.TaxRate AS varchar(20))), '''')'
             ELSE N'''''' END;
    DECLARE @rateJoin nvarchar(400) =
        CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID('dbo.TaxDef') IS NOT NULL
              AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.TaxDef', 'TaxRate') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'LEFT JOIN dbo.TaxDef td ON td.TaxCode = ft.TaxCode'
             ELSE N'' END;

    -- Room-night + lossless coverage column probes (result set 2 appends these
    -- LAST). Each degrades to '' / 0 when its column is absent, so a schema
    -- variant that lacks a column never zeroes a folio line.
    DECLARE @roomExpr nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'OriginRoom') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(ft.OriginRoom AS varchar(20))), '''')' ELSE N'''''' END;
    DECLARE @roomCodeExpr nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'RoomCode') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(ft.RoomCode AS varchar(20))), '''')' ELSE N'''''' END;
    DECLARE @trnDateExpr nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'TransactionDate') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(10), ft.TransactionDate, 23), '''')' ELSE N'''''' END;
    DECLARE @postAccExpr nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'PostToACC') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'CAST(ISNULL(ft.PostToACC, 0) AS bit)' ELSE N'CAST(0 AS bit)' END;
    DECLARE @coverExpr nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'NumberCover') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.NumberCover, 0), 0) AS int)' ELSE N'CAST(0 AS int)' END;
    DECLARE @xrefExpr nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'XRef') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(ft.XRef AS varchar(30))), '''')' ELSE N'''''' END;
    DECLARE @curExpr nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'OriginCurrency') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(ft.OriginCurrency AS varchar(10))), '''')' ELSE N'''''' END;
    DECLARE @oamtExpr nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'OriginAmount') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.OriginAmount, 0), 0) AS bigint)' ELSE N'CAST(0 AS bigint)' END;
    DECLARE @rptRateExpr nvarchar(200) =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'RptExRate') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(ft.RptExRate AS varchar(30))), '''')' ELSE N'''''' END;

    -- Result set 1: header (22 columns, scan order in FetchCollected).
    -- GuestName/Address2/InvContent are shipped-SP superset extensions, and
    -- ConfirmNo/Arrival/Departure/RoomNo are the reservation-detail extensions;
    -- all are omitempty on the Go side, so an install whose BillInfor/Folio lacks
    -- a column can leave the SELECT expression '' and nothing changes for
    -- existing invoices. New columns are appended AFTER the stable ones so the
    -- Go scan offsets never move.
    SELECT TOP (1)
        SellerTaxCode = '' /* set to the property MST */,
        CompanyName   = ISNULL(b.CompanyName, ''),
        CustomerTax   = ISNULL(b.VATCode, ''),
        CustomerAddr  = ISNULL(b.Address1, ''),
        -- Buyer email: SMILE stores the folio's booking email on the GUEST
        -- profile, not on BillInfor (b.EMail is NULL on virtually every folio
        -- here). Resolve it from the folio's FIRST guest: BillInfor.FolioNum →
        -- GuestEveryDay (the per-night guest snapshot) → Profile.Email, taking
        -- the guest with the smallest (FolioSubNum, GuestID) = the primary guest
        -- attached earliest. IsAdditionalName=1 selects real profile-linked
        -- guests (the additional-name rows carry the booking parties; ProfileID>0
        -- excludes the walk-in/no-profile lines whose ProfileID is 0). Falls back
        -- to b.EMail when no guest email exists, so nothing regresses. The gefirst
        -- subquery is guarded: GuestEveryDay/Profile are core SMILE_FO tables, but
        -- the ISNULL keeps a bare install (no match) at today's b.EMail value.
        -- Outer ISNULL(...,'') is required: when BOTH the guest-profile lookup
        -- and b.EMail are empty/NULL, the inner ISNULL/NULLIF chain evaluates
        -- to NULL (not ''), which the Go scan (a plain string, not
        -- sql.NullString) rejects with "converting NULL to string is
        -- unsupported" — silently dropping the bill from every collect cycle.
        CustomerEmail = ISNULL(ISNULL(NULLIF((
            SELECT TOP (1) p.Email
            FROM dbo.GuestEveryDay g
            JOIN dbo.Profile p ON p.ProfileNumber = g.ProfileID
            WHERE g.FolioNum = b.FolioNum
              AND g.IsAdditionalName = 1
              AND g.ProfileID > 0
              AND p.Email IS NOT NULL AND p.Email <> ''
            ORDER BY g.FolioSubNum, g.GuestID
        ), ''), NULLIF(b.EMail, '')), ''),
        CustomerTel   = '',
        InvoiceType   = 'GTGT',
        CodeMode      = 'CO_MA',
        KyHieu        = ISNULL(b.BillSeri1, ''),
        MauSo         = '',
        InvDate       = b.InvDate,
        -- Canonical Subtotal ≡ tổng tiền chưa thuế, derived as Total − Tax so the
        -- hub invariant Subtotal+Tax==Total holds BY CONSTRUCTION and the value is
        -- SERVICE-CHARGE-INCLUSIVE. BillInfor.SubAmount EXCLUDES the service charge
        -- (TotalAmount includes it), so using SubAmount here would break invariant 1
        -- on every SC-bearing folio. ServiceCharge is kept below for information.
        Subtotal      = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.TotalAmount, 0), 0) AS bigint)
                        - CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.TaxAmount, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        ServiceCharge = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.ServiceCharge, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        TaxAmount     = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.TaxAmount, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        TotalAmount   = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(b.TotalAmount, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        -- Superset (verified live on SMILE_FO.BillInfor): the guest name, the
        -- second address line, and the free-text invoice content note.
        GuestName     = ISNULL(b.GuestName, ''),
        BuyerAddress2 = ISNULL(b.Address2, ''),
        InvContent    = ISNULL(b.BillNote, ''),
        -- Booking confirmation number (verified LIVE 2026-07-30 on SMILE_FO):
        -- BillInfor.FolioNum → Folio.ConfirmNum (numeric, always populated for a
        -- real folio). This is the reservation's confirmation no. the Hub threads
        -- into MISA CustomField1. LEFT JOIN + ISNULL so a bill with no matching
        -- folio (or a bare install without dbo.Folio) leaves it '' and nothing
        -- regresses. Cast the numeric to a trimmed string; strip any decimal.
        ConfirmNo     = ISNULL(NULLIF(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(bigint, f.ConfirmNum))), '0'), ''),
        -- Reservation stay dates + room (verified LIVE 2026-07-30 on SMILE_FO):
        -- BillInfor.FolioNum → Folio.ArrivalDate/DepartureDate (datetime) and
        -- Folio.RoomCode (varchar). These feed MISA CheckIn/CheckOut/RoomNo. Same
        -- LEFT JOIN dbo.Folio as ConfirmNo above, so a bill with no matching folio
        -- (or a bare install without dbo.Folio) leaves them '' — nothing regresses.
        -- Dates emitted ISO yyyy-MM-dd; the Hub reformats per provider.
        Arrival       = ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(10), f.ArrivalDate, 23), ''),
        Departure     = ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(10), f.DepartureDate, 23), ''),
        RoomNo        = ISNULL(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(30), f.RoomCode)), '')
    FROM dbo.BillInfor b

    -- (bills 10399/10401/10404): without this filter the Go scan reads an
    -- arbitrary first row and a NULL-totals cancel row zeroes the header.
    -- Same active-bill predicate as sp_SelectPendingFO.

      AND (b.Cancel = 0 OR b.Cancel IS NULL)

    -- live: 1 such BillID); the header must be exactly one row for the Go
    -- scan, and the latest print is the billing truth.

    -- Result set 2: merged folio lines (revenue codes only), 33 cols. The first
    -- 21 are unchanged (stable scan positions in FetchCollected); cols 22-24 —
    -- TrnGroup / IsHKPost / TaxRate — are the ĐỢT 2 raw classification columns;
    -- cols 25-33 — OriginRoom / RoomCode / TransactionDate / PostToACC /
    -- NumberCover / XRef / OriginCurrency / OriginAmount / RptExRate — are the
    -- room-night + lossless coverage columns. All appended so existing scan
    -- offsets never move. Dynamic because the WHERE predicate and the probe
    -- expressions are chosen at run time.
    --
    -- ft.SubAmount is ALWAYS net on this install, independent of @ipHasTax.
    -- VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-28 against the real DXQN SMILE_FO database, bill
    -- 22582: for the two water-bottle lines (TrnCode 540/14), where
    -- ft.SubAmount can be cross-checked against a NET ItemPosted total,
    -- ft.TransactionAmount − ft.SubAmount == ft.TaxAmount + ft.STaxAmount +
    -- ft.ServiceCharge EXACTLY (16000−14110=1890=1185+0+705;
    -- 48000−42328=5672=3556+0+2116), and SubAmount/TransactionAmount is the
    -- SAME ratio (0.8818…) as the System Charge line
    -- (1366843/1550000=0.8818…) — proving SubAmount is already net for every
    -- line on this install, including System Charge, which has no ItemPosted
    -- children to self-check. An earlier attempt to also subtract
    -- Tax+STax+ServiceCharge out of SubAmount here (reusing @ipHasTax as a
    -- proxy) was WRONG — it double-subtracted an already-net figure. Do not
    -- reintroduce that without a fresh live cross-check on the affected
    -- install; TransactionAmount, not SubAmount, is the gross column.
    DECLARE @sql2 nvarchar(max) = N'
    SELECT
        LineKey      = CAST(ft.TransactionID AS varchar(30)),
        -- The source document behind this charge. For POS transfers
        -- (TransactionCode 200/201/210/211) RefNumber IS the POS CheckNo
        -- (VERIFIED LIVE 2026-07-22: 6009/6022 billed charge rows resolve in
        -- SMILE_POS.dbo.Invoice), which the Go collector uses to swap the
        -- opaque transfer summary for the check''s real items (fo_enrich.go).
        -- Other codes carry room numbers / misc refs — Go ignores those.

        TrnCode      = ISNULL(ft.TransactionCode, ''''),
        TrnSubCode   = ISNULL(CAST(ft.TransactionSubCode AS varchar(10)), ''''),
        DescPrimary  = ISNULL(tc.Description, ISNULL(ft.Description, '''')),

        TaxCode      = ISNULL(ft.TaxCode, ''''),
        TaxAmount    = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.TaxAmount, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        STaxCode     = ISNULL(ft.STaxCode, ''''),
        STaxAmount   = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.STaxAmount, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        SrvChgCode   = '''',
        SrvChgAmount = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.ServiceCharge, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        RVC          = '''',
        Outlet       = '''',
        FolioLink    = CAST(@BillID AS varchar(30)),
        OriginFolioNumber = ISNULL(RTRIM(CAST(ft.OriginFolioNumber AS varchar(30))), ''''),
        TrnType      = ISNULL(RTRIM(tc.TransactionType), ''''),
        DiscountAmount = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ft.Discount, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        -- ĐỢT 2 raw classification columns (probe-guarded, appended last):
        --   TrnGroup = dbo.TransactionCode.TransactionGroup catalog label
        --   IsHKPost = FolioTransaction.isHKPost housekeeping/minibar flag
        --   TaxRate  = TaxDef.TaxRate legal-band label (JOIN on ft.TaxCode)
        TrnGroup     = ' + @grpExpr + N',
        IsHKPost     = ' + @hkExpr + N',
        TaxRate      = ' + @rateExpr + N',
        -- Room-night + lossless coverage columns (probe-guarded, appended LAST so
        -- the ĐỢT-2 scan offsets above never move). OriginRoom counts {Rooms},
        -- TransactionDate counts {Nights}; the rest are lossless-only.
        OriginRoom      = ' + @roomExpr + N',
        RoomCode        = ' + @roomCodeExpr + N',
        TransactionDate = ' + @trnDateExpr + N',
        PostToACC       = ' + @postAccExpr + N',
        NumberCover     = ' + @coverExpr + N',
        XRef            = ' + @xrefExpr + N',
        OriginCurrency  = ' + @curExpr + N',
        OriginAmount    = ' + @oamtExpr + N',
        RptExRate       = ' + @rptRateExpr + N'

    -- (reached ItemPosted.ICode -> ItemList.ICode -> ItemList.IGroup =
    -- ItemGroup.GroupCode), the property's own configured setting for that
    -- group. @ipGroupHasNet probes whether IsPriceNet exists at all (older

    -- @ipHasTax's own value (0), preserving the original always-net behaviour.
    -- NOTE: IsPriceNet is a per-group SETTING, not ground truth — it has been
    -- observed wrong on real data for a given group/version (VERIFIED LIVE
    -- 2026-08-30, local SMILE_FO, ICode 1110001 "Minibar" group: IsPriceNet=1
    -- but the real menu price is gross). A pure row-arithmetic check
    -- (Price*Qty vs Amount) CANNOT correct this: Price and Amount are always
    -- mutually consistent on the same row regardless of convention, so that
    -- comparison trivially matches "net" every time and can never discriminate

    -- ServiceChargeAmount/TaxAmount against the property's configured standard
    -- rate × Amount) needs a per-tenant rate constant the SQL layer does not
    -- have; it runs in the Go agent (AgentConfig.StandardServiceChargeRate)
    -- AFTER this SP returns, before the item is pushed to the Hub — see
    -- internal/agentcollector/collectsource.go correctFODetailNetGross and
    -- spec 2026-08-30-fo-detail-net-gross-correction. This SQL signal is the
    -- agent's starting hypothesis, not the final answer.
    DECLARE @ipGroupHasNet bit =
        CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.ItemGroup', 'IsPriceNet') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @ipNetExpr nvarchar(200) = CASE WHEN @ipHasTax = 1 AND @ipGroupHasNet = 1
        THEN N'CASE WHEN ISNULL(ig.IsPriceNet, 1) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END'
        WHEN @ipHasTax = 1 THEN N'1'
        ELSE N'0' END;
    DECLARE @ipAmount nvarchar(1200) = N'
        CASE WHEN ' + @ipNetExpr + N' = 0
             THEN CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.Amount,0) - ISNULL(ip.TaxAmount,0) - ISNULL(ip.STaxAmount,0) - ISNULL(ip.ServiceChargeAmount,0), 0) AS bigint)
             ELSE CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.Amount, 0), 0) AS bigint) END';

    -- 2026-07-22, bill 22066, gross-reconciled row: qty=1 water-bottle ip.Price =
    -- ip.Amount = 16000 = 14110 net + 1185 tax + 705 SC). When the group is
    -- gross, back the per-unit tax+STax+SC share out of Price so UnitPrice
    -- lands on the same net basis as the NET Amount above (UnitPrice × Qty ≈
    -- Amount, up to rounding). When net, Price is already net like the
    -- untouched Amount branch.
    DECLARE @ipUnitPrice nvarchar(1400) = N'
        CASE WHEN ' + @ipNetExpr + N' = 0
             THEN CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.Price,0) - (ISNULL(ip.TaxAmount,0) + ISNULL(ip.STaxAmount,0) + ISNULL(ip.ServiceChargeAmount,0)) / CASE WHEN ISNULL(ip.Qty,0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ip.Qty END, 0) AS bigint)
             ELSE CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.Price, 0), 0) AS bigint) END';
    DECLARE @ipTaxCode  nvarchar(200) = CASE WHEN @ipHasTax = 1 THEN N'ISNULL(ip.TaxCode, '''')'          ELSE N'CAST('''' AS varchar(20))' END;
    DECLARE @ipTax      nvarchar(200) = CASE WHEN @ipHasTax = 1 THEN N'CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.TaxAmount,0),0) AS bigint)'  ELSE N'CAST(0 AS bigint)' END;
    DECLARE @ipSTaxCode nvarchar(200) = CASE WHEN @ipHasTax = 1 THEN N'ISNULL(ip.STaxCode, '''')'         ELSE N'CAST('''' AS varchar(20))' END;
    DECLARE @ipSTax     nvarchar(200) = CASE WHEN @ipHasTax = 1 THEN N'CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.STaxAmount,0),0) AS bigint)' ELSE N'CAST(0 AS bigint)' END;
    DECLARE @ipScCode   nvarchar(200) = CASE WHEN @ipHasTax = 1 THEN N'ISNULL(ip.ServiceChargeCode, '''')' ELSE N'CAST('''' AS varchar(20))' END;
    DECLARE @ipSc       nvarchar(200) = CASE WHEN @ipHasTax = 1 THEN N'CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(ip.ServiceChargeAmount,0),0) AS bigint)' ELSE N'CAST(0 AS bigint)' END;
    DECLARE @sql3 nvarchar(max) = N'
    SELECT
        LineKey      = CAST(ip.TrnID AS varchar(30)),
        DetailKey    = CAST(ip.nSeq AS varchar(30)),
        ICode        = ISNULL(ip.ICode, ''''),
        NamePrimary  = ISNULL(ip.IName, ''''),
        ItemGroup    = ISNULL(ig.GroupName, ''''),
        UnitName     = ISNULL(iu.UnitName, ''''),
        Qty          = CAST(ISNULL(ip.Qty, 1) AS float),
        UnitPrice    = ' + @ipUnitPrice + N',
        Amount       = ' + @ipAmount + N',
        TaxCode      = ' + @ipTaxCode + N',
        TaxAmount    = ' + @ipTax + N',
        STaxCode     = ' + @ipSTaxCode + N',
        STaxAmount   = ' + @ipSTax + N',
        SrvChgCode   = ' + @ipScCode + N',
        SrvChgAmount = ' + @ipSc + N'
    FROM dbo.ItemPosted ip
    LEFT JOIN dbo.ItemList il ON RTRIM(il.ICode) = RTRIM(ip.ICode)
    LEFT JOIN dbo.ItemGroup ig ON RTRIM(ig.GroupCode) = RTRIM(il.IGroup)
    LEFT JOIN dbo.ItemUnit iu ON RTRIM(iu.UnitCode) = RTRIM(il.IUnit)
    WHERE ip.TrnID IN (
        SELECT ft.TransactionID FROM dbo.FolioTransaction ft
        WHERE ft.BillID = @BillID
          AND (' + @pred + N'));';
    EXEC sp_executesql @sql3, N'@BillID numeric', @BillID = @BillID;
END;

-- @ID is the POS CheckNo (see sp_SelectPendingPOS — the checks and their real
-- money live on dbo.Invoice/dbo.Trn; TaxTable/VATBillInfor are too sparse to
-- key off and here carry buyer identity only).
--
-- sp_FetchPOS v2 — the agent no longer synthesizes per-line VAT by
-- apportionment. dbo.Trn carries the EXACT per-line money and rate bucket, so
-- this SP hands the raw Trn rows + Invoice header straight to the Go
-- normalizer (internal/agent/pos_normalize.go), which apportions discount,
-- derives+verifies the legal VAT rate, and reconciles against the header.
--
-- VERIFIED LIVE on SMILE_POS, 2026:
--  - dbo.Invoice header money reconciles EXACTLY:
--    BeforeTax = SubTotal + Discount + SurCharge; TotalBase = BeforeTax +
--    TaxTotal. Discount is stored NEGATIVE. SurCharge is a check-level service
--    charge applied post-discount (SC% = SurCharge/(SubTotal+Discount)).
--  - dbo.Trn.TrnCode discriminates row purpose: 100 = revenue item line,
--    110 = discount line (negative BaseSub/BaseTax). 200/300 = payment,
--    400/570 = other non-revenue postings — excluded here.
--  - dbo.Trn carries the exact per-line money: BaseSub (net), BaseTax (VAT),
--    TaxNo (rate bucket: 8 -> 8%, 1 -> 10%), BaseSTax/STaxNo (service-tax,
--    unused on this install — 0). Trn.TotalR/TaxR are RATE-SCALED, not VND, so
--    they are NOT read. Proven: check 200021466 Σ BaseSub=535000=SubTotal,
--    Σ BaseTax=44940=TaxTotal (exact); discounted check 200021431 reconciles
--    exactly incl. the negative 110-row (52164 = 57960 - 5796).
--  - dbo.TaxTable (1 row/check, keyed TCheckNo=CheckNo) carries buyer identity
--    (ClientVAT/ClientName/Company/Address + InvContent) on this
--    install; its money buckets are NULL and are NOT read here. LEFT JOIN so a
--    check with no TaxTable row still fetches (buyer fields default to '').
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_FetchPOS @ID varchar(64) AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @CheckNo numeric = TRY_CONVERT(numeric, @ID);

    -- Result set 1: header (one row) — check-level money truth off dbo.Invoice
    -- + buyer identity off dbo.TaxTable. Scan order fixed in fetchPOSRaw.
    -- InvDate is rebuilt from the integer date parts (IYear/IMonth/IDay) plus
    -- CloseTime's time-of-day so a source-issued date survives even when
    -- OpenTime/CloseTime lack a stable calendar date on this schema.
    SELECT
        SubTotal   = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.SubTotal, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        Discount   = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.Discount, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        SurCharge  = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.SurCharge, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        BeforeTax  = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.BeforeTax, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        TaxTotal   = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.TaxTotal, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        STaxTotal  = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.STaxTotal, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        TotalBase  = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(i.TotalBase, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        InvStatus  = CAST(ISNULL(i.InvStatus, 0) AS int),
        TaxOmit    = CAST(ISNULL(i.TaxOmit, 0) AS int),
        RVC        = CAST(ISNULL(i.RVC, 0) AS int),
        FolioNum   = ISNULL(CAST(i.FolioNum AS varchar(30)), ''),
        InvDate    = DATEADD(day, ISNULL(i.IDay, 1) - 1,
                     DATEADD(month, ISNULL(i.IMonth, 1) - 1,
                     DATEADD(year, ISNULL(i.IYear, 1900) - 1900,
                     CAST(CAST(i.CloseTime AS time) AS datetime)))),
        ExRate     = CAST(ISNULL(i.ExRate, 1) AS float),
        ClientVAT  = ISNULL(tt.ClientVAT, ''),
        ClientName = ISNULL(tt.ClientName, ''),
        Company    = ISNULL(tt.Company, ''),
        Address    = ISNULL(tt.Address, ''),
        InvContent = ISNULL(tt.InvContent, '')
    FROM dbo.Invoice i
    LEFT JOIN dbo.TaxTable tt ON tt.TCheckNo = i.CheckNo
    WHERE i.CheckNo = @CheckNo;

    -- Result set 2: revenue + discount lines off dbo.Trn (TrnCode IN (100,110)),
    -- 14 cols. Money columns are the EXACT per-line net/VAT/service-charge/
    -- service-tax; the Go normalizer apportions the 110-row discount across the
    -- 100-rows, derives the legal rate from (BaseSub, BaseTax) and reconciles to
    -- the header.
    --
    -- đơn vị tính resolves ItemCode -> ItemDef.IUnit -> IUnitDef.UnitName.
    -- VERIFIED LIVE 2026-07-15: resolves on 16235/16235 (100%) of the 2026
    -- revenue rows (PART, CUP, GLASS, CAN, BOTTLE, SET, PHONG, LY, CHAI, ...).
    -- The join is on ICode ALONE and deliberately not RVC-scoped: ItemDef.RVC is
    -- NULL on all 1731 rows of this install, so any RVC predicate matches
    -- nothing and silently blanks every unit.
    --
    -- Nhóm hàng hóa (item group) is NOT emitted: it does not exist on this
    -- install. VERIFIED LIVE 2026-07-15: Trn.GroupCode = 0 on all 16235 2026
    -- revenue rows and ItemDef.IGroup = '0' on every row, so a Group column
    -- could only ever be a constant ''. Adding one would put an always-empty
    -- field in the payload and the source hash for no data. A DBA on an install
    -- that populates IGroup can join IGroupDef here and append the column AFTER
    -- UnitName, then extend the Go scan in the same order.
    SELECT
        TrnSeq    = CAST(t.TrnSeq AS int),
        TrnCode   = CAST(t.TrnCode AS int),
        ItemCode  = ISNULL(t.ItemCode, ''),
        TrnDesc   = ISNULL(t.TrnDesc, ''),
        UnitName  = ISNULL(ud.UnitName, ''),
        Qty       = CAST(ISNULL(t.TrnQty, 1) AS float),
        UnitPrice = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.ItemPrice, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        BaseSub   = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseSub, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        -- BaseSrc is the EXACT per-line service charge (phí phục vụ). BaseSub
        -- EXCLUDES it and BaseTax is levied on (BaseSub + BaseSrc), which is why
        -- the Go rate band tolerates a ratio up to r x 1.15.
        -- VERIFIED LIVE 2026-07-15: SUM(BaseSrc) over TrnCode IN (100,110)
        -- equals Invoice.SurCharge on 3139/3139 of the 2026 checks. It must be
        -- summed over BOTH codes: 94 of 95 discount rows carry a non-zero
        -- BaseSrc (the SC reduction that rides the discount), and counting only
        -- the 100-rows reconciles on just 3101/3139.
        BaseSrc   = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseSrc, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        BaseTax   = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseTax, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        TaxNo     = CAST(ISNULL(t.TaxNo, 0) AS int),
        BaseSTax  = CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(t.BaseSTax, 0), 0) AS bigint),
        STaxNo    = CAST(ISNULL(t.STaxNo, 0) AS int),
        RVC       = CAST(ISNULL(t.RVC, 0) AS int)
    FROM dbo.Trn t
    LEFT JOIN dbo.ItemDef idf ON RTRIM(idf.ICode) = RTRIM(t.ItemCode)
    LEFT JOIN dbo.IUnitDef ud ON RTRIM(ud.UnitCode) = RTRIM(idf.IUnit)
    WHERE t.CheckNo = @CheckNo
      AND t.TrnCode IN (100, 110)
    ORDER BY t.TrnSeq;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_MarkCollected
    @Source varchar(4), @ID varchar(64), @Ok bit, @Message nvarchar(400) = NULL AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    -- Record the fingerprint of the source rows we just pushed, so the next
    -- select can tell "unchanged since push" (skip) from "edited since push"
    -- (re-collect). Computed from the SAME function the select SPs use — the
    -- two MUST agree or change-detection breaks.
    --
    -- A re-push whose source CHANGED (fingerprint differs from the stored one)
    -- also CLEARS the issued-value flags: the bill is treated as a NEW invoice
    -- and the old number/mã CQT no longer describe it. The Hub issues a new
    -- version and the writeback re-populates these columns. An unchanged
    -- re-mark (same hash) keeps them.
    DECLARE @Hash varbinary(32) = dbo.MMEI_SourceHash(@Source, @ID);
    MERGE dbo.MMEI_Collected AS tgt
    USING (SELECT @Source AS Source, @ID AS ID) AS src
        ON tgt.Source = src.Source AND tgt.ID = src.ID
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
        Ok = @Ok, Message = @Message, PushedAt = GETDATE(),
        InvoiceNumber = CASE WHEN tgt.SourceHash = @Hash THEN tgt.InvoiceNumber END,
        KyHieu        = CASE WHEN tgt.SourceHash = @Hash THEN tgt.KyHieu END,
        MaCQT         = CASE WHEN tgt.SourceHash = @Hash THEN tgt.MaCQT END,
        IssuedAt      = CASE WHEN tgt.SourceHash = @Hash THEN tgt.IssuedAt END,
        SourceHash = @Hash
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (Source, ID, Ok, Message, SourceHash)
        VALUES (@Source, @ID, @Ok, @Message, @Hash);
END;
