scripts.input:
-- sp_ProbeFOSchema reports, for THIS SMILE_FO install, which columns/tables the
-- ĐỢT 2 (2026-07-25 plan) FO revenue predicates need before any of them are
-- wired into sp_FetchFO/01_source_hash. It changes nothing and reads no row
-- data beyond a COUNT — safe to run on every enroll/collect cycle so the Hub
-- log carries the real schema shape from a customer install the dev box
-- cannot see (no live SMILE available in dev).
--
-- Every optional column/table is probed via COL_LENGTH/OBJECT_ID and only
-- referenced from DYNAMIC SQL (sp_executesql) gated on that probe — so a
-- missing column/table never breaks this SP itself, whatever the schema
-- variant. All checks are gathered into local variables, then returned as a
-- single one-row result set.
--
-- Columns returned:
--   HasTransactionGroup       bit    -- dbo.TransactionCode.TransactionGroup exists
--   HasFolioBalanceCode       bit    -- dbo.FolioTransaction.FolioBalanceCode exists
--   HasIsHKPost               bit    -- dbo.FolioTransaction.isHKPost exists
--   HasTaxDef                 bit    -- dbo.TaxDef table exists
--   HasTaxDefRate              bit    -- dbo.TaxDef.TaxRate column exists
--   DistinctFolioBalanceCodes nvarchar(400) -- STRING_AGG of DISTINCT FolioBalanceCode seen, '' if column absent
--   Group1Count                int    -- COUNT(*) of dbo.TransactionCode rows with TransactionGroup=1, -1 if column absent
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_ProbeFOSchema AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @HasTransactionGroup BIT = CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.TransactionCode', 'TransactionGroup') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @HasFolioBalanceCode BIT = CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'FolioBalanceCode') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @HasIsHKPost BIT = CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.FolioTransaction', 'isHKPost') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @HasTaxDef BIT = CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID('dbo.TaxDef') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @HasTaxDefRate BIT = CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('dbo.TaxDef', 'TaxRate') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

    DECLARE @DistinctFolioBalanceCodes NVARCHAR(400) = N'';
    IF @HasFolioBalanceCode = 1
    BEGIN
        -- STRING_AGG is SQL Server 2017+ only — unavailable on 2016 RTM/SP1/SP2
        -- customer installs. FOR XML PATH('') is the pre-2017 comma-join idiom
        -- (works back to SQL Server 2005); STUFF(...,1,1,'') strips the leading
        -- comma the same way STRING_AGG's separator placement would not add.
        DECLARE @sqlCodes NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'SELECT @out = ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT N'','' + CAST(RTRIM(FolioBalanceCode) AS nvarchar(50)) FROM dbo.FolioTransaction FOR XML PATH('''')), 1, 1, N''''), N'''')';
        EXEC sp_executesql @sqlCodes, N'@out NVARCHAR(400) OUTPUT', @out = @DistinctFolioBalanceCodes OUTPUT;
    END

    DECLARE @Group1Count INT = -1;
    IF @HasTransactionGroup = 1
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @sqlGroup1 NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'SELECT @out = COUNT(*) FROM dbo.TransactionCode WHERE TransactionGroup = 1';
        EXEC sp_executesql @sqlGroup1, N'@out INT OUTPUT', @out = @Group1Count OUTPUT;
    END

    SELECT
        HasTransactionGroup       = @HasTransactionGroup,
        HasFolioBalanceCode       = @HasFolioBalanceCode,
        HasIsHKPost               = @HasIsHKPost,
        HasTaxDef                 = @HasTaxDef,
        HasTaxDefRate             = @HasTaxDefRate,
        DistinctFolioBalanceCodes = @DistinctFolioBalanceCodes,
        Group1Count               = @Group1Count;
END
GO

scripts.name: sp_SelectPendingFO.sql
scripts.input:
-- @CollectFrom filters by issue date; NULL = no window. KEEP IN SYNC with AgentConfig.CollectFrom.
--
-- @Mode splits the cheap "never sent" selection from the costly edit detection
-- (RT-0784). Old agents pass only @Limit/@CollectFrom and get mode 0, the
-- original combined query, unchanged. New agents probe sys.parameters for
-- @Mode and call:
--   1 = never sent OK (no hash work)               -> one column ID
--   2 = sent, dated >= @ChangedFrom, source edited  -> one column ID
--   3 = sweep page: the next @Limit sent bills below key @After (BillID DESC),
--       each with Changed = 1 when its source was edited -> columns ID, Changed
-- Modes 2 and 3 copy their candidates into a table variable using only cheap
-- filters, then hash, so dbo.MMEI_SourceHash never runs over the whole table.
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_SelectPendingFO @Limit int = 50, @CollectFrom datetime = NULL,
    @Mode tinyint = 0, @ChangedFrom datetime = NULL, @After varchar(64) = NULL AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF @Mode = 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (@Limit) ID = CAST(b.BillID AS varchar(64))
        FROM dbo.BillInfor b
        LEFT JOIN dbo.MMEI_Collected c
            ON c.Source = 'FO'
           AND c.ID = CAST(b.BillID AS varchar(64))
           AND c.Ok = 1
           AND c.SourceHash IS NOT NULL
        WHERE b.Printed = 1
          AND (b.Cancel = 0 OR b.Cancel IS NULL)
          AND b.BillID IS NOT NULL
          AND (@CollectFrom IS NULL OR b.InvDate >= @CollectFrom)
          AND c.ID IS NULL
        ORDER BY b.BillID DESC;
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @Mode IN (2, 3)
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @cand TABLE (BillID numeric(38, 0) NOT NULL, SourceHash varbinary(32) NOT NULL);
        DECLARE @AfterID numeric(38, 0);
        IF @Mode = 3 SET @AfterID = CONVERT(numeric(38, 0), @After);

        IF @Mode = 2
            INSERT @cand (BillID, SourceHash)
            SELECT b.BillID, c.SourceHash
            FROM dbo.BillInfor b
            JOIN dbo.MMEI_Collected c
                ON c.Source = 'FO'
               AND c.ID = CAST(b.BillID AS varchar(64))
               AND c.Ok = 1
               AND c.SourceHash IS NOT NULL
            WHERE b.Printed = 1
              AND (b.Cancel = 0 OR b.Cancel IS NULL)
              AND b.BillID IS NOT NULL
              AND (@CollectFrom IS NULL OR b.InvDate >= @CollectFrom)
              AND (@ChangedFrom IS NULL OR b.InvDate >= @ChangedFrom);
        ELSE
            INSERT @cand (BillID, SourceHash)
            SELECT TOP (@Limit) b.BillID, c.SourceHash
            FROM dbo.BillInfor b
            JOIN dbo.MMEI_Collected c
                ON c.Source = 'FO'
               AND c.ID = CAST(b.BillID AS varchar(64))
               AND c.Ok = 1
               AND c.SourceHash IS NOT NULL
            WHERE b.Printed = 1
              AND (b.Cancel = 0 OR b.Cancel IS NULL)
              AND b.BillID IS NOT NULL
              AND (@CollectFrom IS NULL OR b.InvDate >= @CollectFrom)
              AND (@AfterID IS NULL OR b.BillID < @AfterID)
            ORDER BY b.BillID DESC;

        IF @Mode = 2
            SELECT TOP (@Limit) ID = CAST(x.BillID AS varchar(64))
            FROM @cand x
            WHERE x.SourceHash <> dbo.MMEI_SourceHash('FO', CAST(x.BillID AS varchar(64)))
            ORDER BY x.BillID DESC;
        ELSE
            SELECT ID = CAST(x.BillID AS varchar(64)),
                   Changed = CAST(CASE WHEN x.SourceHash <> dbo.MMEI_SourceHash('FO', CAST(x.BillID AS varchar(64)))
                                       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bit)
            FROM @cand x
            ORDER BY x.BillID DESC;
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- Mode 0 (old agents). Change-aware pending set: select a bill when it was
    -- never pushed OK, OR when its current source fingerprint differs from the
    -- one last pushed (i.e. the source data changed and the Hub should see the
    -- update). An already-issued invoice is handled Hub-side (a changed payload
    -- creates a new version; the issued one is never overwritten).
    -- PERF: same shape as sp_SelectPendingPOS — the hash re-reads every child
    -- row, so it may only run for bills that already carry an Ok mark; a plain
    -- NOT EXISTS evaluated it per candidate and grows linearly with the
    -- never-pushed backlog.
    SELECT TOP (@Limit) ID = CAST(b.BillID AS varchar(64))
    FROM dbo.BillInfor b
    LEFT JOIN dbo.MMEI_Collected c
        ON c.Source = 'FO'
       AND c.ID = CAST(b.BillID AS varchar(64))
       AND c.Ok = 1
       AND c.SourceHash IS NOT NULL
    WHERE b.Printed = 1

-- is NOT a reliable "is this check collectable" gate (VATBillInfor is even
-- sparser: zero rows this period). The real check list with real money lives
-- on dbo.Invoice, so the pending set is driven off dbo.Invoice directly and
-- keyed by CheckNo (not BillSeri/BillNo, which are frequently NULL).
--

-- agents) = the original combined query; 1 = never sent; 2 = sent, dated
-- >= @ChangedFrom and edited; 3 = sweep page below CheckNo @After returning
-- ID, Changed. Modes 2/3 hash only a table variable of cheap-filtered candidates.

    @Mode tinyint = 0, @ChangedFrom datetime = NULL, @After varchar(64) = NULL AS
BEGIN

    IF @Mode = 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (@Limit) ID = CAST(i.CheckNo AS varchar(64))
        FROM dbo.Invoice i
        LEFT JOIN dbo.MMEI_Collected c
            ON c.Source = 'POS'
           AND c.ID = CAST(i.CheckNo AS varchar(64))
           AND c.Ok = 1
           AND c.SourceHash IS NOT NULL
        WHERE i.InvStatus = 0
          AND i.Status = 1
          AND (i.Refund = 0 OR i.Refund IS NULL)
          AND i.CheckNo IS NOT NULL
          AND ISNULL(i.FolioNum, 0) = 0
          AND (@CollectFrom IS NULL OR ISNULL(i.CloseTime, i.OpenTime) >= @CollectFrom)
          AND c.ID IS NULL
        ORDER BY i.CheckNo DESC;
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @Mode IN (2, 3)
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @cand TABLE (CheckNo numeric(38, 0) NOT NULL, SourceHash varbinary(32) NOT NULL);
        DECLARE @AfterNo numeric(38, 0);
        IF @Mode = 3 SET @AfterNo = CONVERT(numeric(38, 0), @After);

        IF @Mode = 2
            INSERT @cand (CheckNo, SourceHash)
            SELECT i.CheckNo, c.SourceHash
            FROM dbo.Invoice i
            JOIN dbo.MMEI_Collected c
                ON c.Source = 'POS'
               AND c.ID = CAST(i.CheckNo AS varchar(64))
               AND c.Ok = 1
               AND c.SourceHash IS NOT NULL
            WHERE i.InvStatus = 0
              AND i.Status = 1

              AND i.CheckNo IS NOT NULL
              AND ISNULL(i.FolioNum, 0) = 0
              AND (@CollectFrom IS NULL OR ISNULL(i.CloseTime, i.OpenTime) >= @CollectFrom)
              AND (@ChangedFrom IS NULL OR ISNULL(i.CloseTime, i.OpenTime) >= @ChangedFrom);
        ELSE
            INSERT @cand (CheckNo, SourceHash)
            SELECT TOP (@Limit) i.CheckNo, c.SourceHash
            FROM dbo.Invoice i
            JOIN dbo.MMEI_Collected c
                ON c.Source = 'POS'
               AND c.ID = CAST(i.CheckNo AS varchar(64))
               AND c.Ok = 1
               AND c.SourceHash IS NOT NULL
            WHERE i.InvStatus = 0
              AND i.Status = 1
              AND (i.Refund = 0 OR i.Refund IS NULL)
              AND i.CheckNo IS NOT NULL
              AND ISNULL(i.FolioNum, 0) = 0
              AND (@CollectFrom IS NULL OR ISNULL(i.CloseTime, i.OpenTime) >= @CollectFrom)
              AND (@AfterNo IS NULL OR i.CheckNo < @AfterNo)
            ORDER BY i.CheckNo DESC;

        IF @Mode = 2
            SELECT TOP (@Limit) ID = CAST(x.CheckNo AS varchar(64))
            FROM @cand x
            WHERE x.SourceHash <> dbo.MMEI_SourceHash('POS', CAST(x.CheckNo AS varchar(64)))
            ORDER BY x.CheckNo DESC;
        ELSE
            SELECT ID = CAST(x.CheckNo AS varchar(64)),
                   Changed = CAST(CASE WHEN x.SourceHash <> dbo.MMEI_SourceHash('POS', CAST(x.CheckNo AS varchar(64)))
                                       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bit)
            FROM @cand x
            ORDER BY x.CheckNo DESC;
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- Mode 0 (old agents) below.
    -- Change-aware pending set: same contract as sp_SelectPendingFO. Select a
    -- check when it was never pushed OK, OR when its current source
    -- fingerprint differs from the one last pushed.
    --
    -- Status filter: InvStatus=0 AND Status=1 covers 100% of the verified
    -- July 2026 checks (169/169, all closed/finalized). Refund=0 excludes
    -- refund checks. KEEP IN SYNC with the property's void/cancel convention
    -- if this install ever produces other InvStatus/Status/Refund values.
    -- FO-dedup gate: a folio-charged check (FolioNum set) is invoiced by the FO
    -- side as part of the guest's folio bill — excluding it here prevents
    -- double-issuance. The source-hash covers FolioNum, so a later unlink
    -- (FolioNum cleared) re-admits the check to this pending set.
    -- PERF: dbo.MMEI_SourceHash re-reads every child row of a check, so it must
    -- run ONLY for checks that already have an Ok mark (change detection), never
    -- for the never-pushed majority — a plain NOT EXISTS with the hash inside
    -- the predicate let the optimizer evaluate it per candidate row and timed
    -- out live (>120s over ~5k pending checks, 2026-07-22). LEFT JOIN the mark
    -- first; the CASE only invokes the hash when a mark row exists.
    SELECT TOP (@Limit) ID = CAST(i.CheckNo AS varchar(64))
    FROM dbo.Invoice i
    LEFT JOIN dbo.MMEI_Collected c
        ON c.Source = 'POS'
       AND c.ID = CAST(i.CheckNo AS varchar(64))
       AND c.Ok = 1
       AND c.SourceHash IS NOT NULL
    WHERE i.InvStatus = 0
      AND i.Status = 1
      AND (i.Refund = 0 OR i.Refund IS NULL)
      AND i.CheckNo IS NOT NULL
      AND ISNULL(i.FolioNum, 0) = 0
      AND (@CollectFrom IS NULL OR ISNULL(i.CloseTime, i.OpenTime) >= @CollectFrom)
      AND (c.ID IS NULL
           OR c.SourceHash <> dbo.MMEI_SourceHash('POS', CAST(i.CheckNo AS varchar(64))))
    ORDER BY i.CheckNo DESC;
END;
